original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区爆发战斗后互联网受限
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区本周爆发地区武装与政府军之间的战斗，国有电信运营商Ethio Telecom的互联网和通话服务已被完全切断，私营运营商Safaricom服务仍在运行。据路透社消息人士称，控制提格雷的提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）下令实施通信封锁，但该组织尚未置评。当地居民称现金短缺、城市如同宵禁，外界难以核实当地实际情况。

location.raw_text: Ethiopia's northern region of Tigray, Mekelle

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区爆发地区武装与政府军之间的战斗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Internet and call services have been disrupted in Ethiopia's northern region of Tigray following the outbreak of fighting this week between regional forces and the national army.

key_facts.fact: 国有电信运营商Ethio Telecom服务被完全切断，私营Safaricom仍运行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Services provided by state-owned telecoms operator Ethio Telecom have been completely cut, although those from the smaller private firm Safaricom remain operational.

key_facts.fact: 据路透社消息人士称，TPLF下令实施通信封锁，但该组织未置评
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sources have told the Reuters news agency that the group which controls Tigray, the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), ordered the communications blackout, with one suggesting it was to disrupt government drones. The TPLF has not commented.

key_facts.fact: 提格雷武装与盟友同埃塞俄比亚联邦部队周三爆发冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Clashes between Tigrayan forces and their allies and Ethiopia's federal troops broke out on Wednesday, prompting fears of a return to a full scale civil war and reports of panic buying.

key_facts.fact: 人道主义消息人士称阿法尔与提格雷之间阿巴拉镇附近发生激烈战斗，包括无人机打击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A humanitarian source in the neighbouring region of Afar told the AFP news agency there was "heavy fighting overnight", including drone strikes, around the town of Abala in the mountains between Afar and Tigray

key_facts.fact: TPLF宣布与另外六个武装组织结盟以推翻政府
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Sunday, the TPLF announced an alliance with six other armed groups to oust the government.

key_facts.fact: TPLF武装从联邦警察手中夺取三座机场控制权，埃塞俄比亚航空取消所有飞往提格雷航班
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Wednesday, its forces seized control of three airports from federal police. Following the seizure of the airports, Ethiopian Airlines has cancelled all flights to Tigray.

uncertainties: 通信封锁由谁下令尚未证实，路透社消息人士称系TPLF所为，但TPLF未置评
BBC无法进入提格雷及周边地区报道，当地实际情况难以核实
阿巴拉镇附近战斗及无人机打击来自单一AFP人道主义消息源
